title: Cam Ward remains confident that he's "a very good quarterback"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cam Ward remains confident that he's "a very good quarterback"
sources.description: Titans quarterback Cam Ward opened his second NFL season with a 23-10 loss to the Jets and head coach Robert Saleh said after the game that Ward "is at the floor of what it takes to be an NFL quarterback."
